messages:
Nora: Heads-up: launching Mosaic Mini pilot (8 accounts) 9/12-9/14. Goals: localized quickstart, SSO validation, embeddings sanity, and an early churn nudge if uptake low. Need owners for invites, localized docs, creds, and SFDC health tags.

Eli: I can do invites + the kickoff template. Proposal: 20m demo + 10m triage. Will include a one-line consent and link to quickstart.

June: Ill translate quickstart to ES/FR and create a 1-page screenshot guide. Will need final UI copy by Friday.

Marco: Ill provision preview creds and a short key-rotation note. Also will generate a tiny sample ingest script customers can run pre-kickoff.

Nora: Thanks. Also want a tiny 3-question survey post-demo and an automated rule: if demo not attended OR sample ingest fails -> set SFDC preview_mosaic_health = amber; if survey avg <3 or two blockers -> red.

Eli: Draft survey: 1) How useful was the demo? (1-5) 2) Any blockers? 3) Would you like a follow-up infra call? Link: https://forms.gle/mosaic-mini-feedback

June: Consent copy for translations: "By joining this preview you consent to collection of aggregated telemetry for product improvement; no PII will be exported." Will translate and post.

Marco: Sample ingest snippet (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <preview_key>" -d '{"items":["hello","world"]}'
```
Ill attach PowerShell equivalent.

ops-bot: Calendar events created: Mosaic Mini Kickoffs 9/12-9/14 (8 slots). Tracking sheet: https://drive.redwood/mosaic-mini-track. SFDC automation: preview_mosaic_health mapping added.

Nora: Great. Please push invites by EOD and post templates to /templates/mosaic-mini. Quick sync tomorrow 11:00 PT to confirm translations + SFDC rules. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
